# ComfyUI Workflow Extractor · ComfyUI 工作流提取器

[中文文档](README.md)

**v1.1** · Restore complete workflows from PNG images generated by ComfyUI, with per-section copying of prompts / parameters / nodes / connections.

A local desktop tool (macOS / Windows) that also runs as a pure front-end page in the browser. All parsing happens on your machine — no network access, no images or data are uploaded.

---

## Features

- **One-click extraction**: Select a PNG exported by ComfyUI and automatically read the embedded `workflow` (editor format) and `prompt` (API format) metadata.
- **Four structured sections**: Prompts, parameters, nodes, and connections are shown separately, plus the complete raw JSON.
- **Per-section copy**: Each section has a "Copy All" button in its top-right corner that writes that section to the system clipboard; each prompt can also be copied individually.
- **Complete workflow**: Copy / download / write back to the image's original directory with one click (creates a same-named `.json`; an extra `.api.json` when both formats exist).
- **Cross-platform clipboard**: Three-tier fallback strategy; copying works on both macOS and Windows.

---

## What's New in v1.1

| Item | Description |
| --- | --- |
| New "Parameters" section | Shows scalar settings such as `seed` / `steps` / `cfg` / `sampler_name` / `denoise` / model name |
| Copy buttons in four sections | Prompts, parameters, nodes, and connections each have "Copy All"; prompts also support single-item copy |
| Fixed prompt detection | Now recognizes the `text` input key of `CLIPTextEncode` (the old version only matched `prompt`, leaving the prompt section empty) |
| Fixed connection parsing | Now accepts string node IDs used by the API format (e.g. `["4", 0]`); the old version only accepted numbers, yielding zero connections |
| Three-tier clipboard fallback | `navigator.clipboard` → Python bridge (macOS `pbcopy` / Windows `ctypes` clipboard) → `execCommand` |
| Unified version number | App title, page title, bundle version, and installer filenames all set to 1.1 |

## Installation

Pre-built packages can also be downloaded directly from this repository: <https://github.com/sailor0990/comfyui-workflow-extractor/tree/main/packages>.
CI automatically builds macOS and Windows packages on every push; artifacts can be downloaded from the [Actions](https://github.com/sailor0990/comfyui-workflow-extractor/actions) page.

### macOS

- `packages/macos/ComfyUI-Workflow-Extractor-v1.1-macOS.dmg` — double-click to mount, then drag the app into Applications.
- `packages/macos/ComfyUI-Workflow-Extractor-v1.1-macOS.pkg` — double-click to run the standard installer, installing to `/Applications`.

> The app is not code-signed. If macOS blocks the first launch: right-click → Open, or run
> `sudo xattr -dr com.apple.quarantine "/Applications/ComfyUI Workflow Extractor.app"`

### Windows

- `packages/windows/ComfyUI-Workflow-Extractor-v1.1-Windows.zip` — unzip and double-click `ComfyUI-Workflow-Extractor.exe`.

> Requires **WebView2 Runtime** (built into Windows 10/11 by default). Older LTSC builds can install it from
> <https://developer.microsoft.com/microsoft-edge/webview2/>.

---

## Usage

1. Open the app → click "Select Image", or drag a PNG into the window.
2. The page displays sections: **Prompts**, **Parameters**, **Nodes**, **Connections**, and **Raw JSON**.
3. Click "Copy All" in the section you need; prompts can also be copied one by one.
4. Click "Save to Original Directory" to create a same-named `.json` next to the PNG (plus `.api.json` when both formats exist).

---

## Requirements for Images

- **Must be PNG**: ComfyUI's Save Image node outputs PNG only and writes text chunks; JPG/WebP do not contain them.
- **Must be written directly by ComfyUI's Save Image node**: third-party save nodes that omit metadata, or metadata writing disabled, produce no embedded workflow.
- **Must not be externally re-encoded / edited / compressed**: copying and renaming are safe; re-saving in Photoshop/Preview, compression by WeChat/QQ, or re-exporting from a collage tool all destroy the `tEXt` chunks.
- **The metadata reflects the workflow at generation time**, not the current state of the ComfyUI editor.
- Two JSON payloads are embedded: `workflow` (editor format, with node positions / widgets / links) and `prompt` (API format, `class_type` + `inputs`, where links are `[source node, output index]`).

---

## How It Works

1. ComfyUI serializes the workflow and writes it into PNG `tEXt` chunks (keys `workflow` / `prompt`).
2. This program parses the PNG chunk structure chunk by chunk (`tEXt` / `iTXt` / `zTXt`) and extracts the JSON.
3. The front end normalizes the JSON into four views: prompts, parameters, nodes, and connections.
4. In desktop mode the page is served by a local loopback HTTP server (`127.0.0.1:<random port>`) to avoid `file://` path-encoding issues; copying and file writing go through the Python bridge.

## Building from Source

### Common setup

```bash
python3 -m venv build_venv
source build_venv/bin/activate      # Windows: build_venv\Scripts\activate
pip install -r requirements.txt
```

### macOS (.app / .dmg / .pkg)

```bash
bash build.sh
```

Outputs: `dist/ComfyUI Workflow Extractor.app`, `ComfyUI-Workflow-Extractor-v1.1-macOS.dmg`, `ComfyUI-Workflow-Extractor-v1.1-macOS.pkg`

### Windows (single-file EXE)

```bat
build_windows.bat
```

Outputs: `dist\ComfyUI-Workflow-Extractor.exe`, `ComfyUI-Workflow-Extractor-v1.1-Windows.zip`

### Browser mode (no installation)

```bash
python3 server.py
# open http://localhost:8000/index.html
```

> In browser mode, writing back to the original directory relies on the File System Access API (Chrome / Edge); other browsers fall back to downloading a same-named `.json`.

---

## Directory Structure

```
.
├── app.py                              # Desktop entry: pywebview window + PNG parsing + clipboard/file bridge
├── index.html                          # UI (shared by browser and desktop modes)
├── server.py                           # Dependency-free local server for browser mode
├── requirements.txt
├── build.sh                            # macOS packaging (app + dmg + pkg)
├── build_windows.bat                   # Windows packaging (exe + zip)
├── ComfyUI Workflow Extractor.spec     # PyInstaller spec (macOS)
├── ComfyUI Workflow Extractor-windows.spec
├── cli/
│   └── comfyui_workflow_extractor.py   # CLI version: batch extraction, no GUI
├── packages/                           # Pre-built distributions
│   ├── macos/
│   └── windows/
└── .github/workflows/build.yml         # CI: dual-platform automated builds
```

---

## CLI Version (Optional)

```bash
python3 cli/comfyui_workflow_extractor.py --folder ~/ComfyUI/output   # batch
python3 cli/comfyui_workflow_extractor.py a.png b.png                 # specific files
python3 cli/comfyui_workflow_extractor.py --check a.png               # preview only
```

---

## Known Limitations

- Cannot parse images that have been re-encoded or compressed by messaging apps.
- The macOS app is unsigned and not notarized; manual approval is required on first launch.
- The Windows package requires the WebView2 Runtime.
